d: Watch as Firstpost breaks down the major diplomatic breakthrough at the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow, where President Vladimir Putin’s Russia has thrown its full weight behind Ghana’s bid to join BRICS as a partner country. With Foreign Minister Samuel Ablakwa securing Moscow's backing, the Mahama administration is pushing to break free from the colonial-era model of exporting raw materials and importing finished goods. As Samia Nkrumah highlights the urgent Pan-African vision for a common market and currency that bypasses the US dollar, Accra is using BRICS to expand development…
